register.title: Set up your GSTFY workspace
register.subtitle: Enter your company, GST registration, and account details manually for the first rollout.
register.rolloutHint: Current rollout supports one company under a manually entered GST registration. Additional branches can be added later from the dashboard.
register.termsNotice: By clicking Create account, you agree to our <terms>Terms of Service</terms> and <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.

helpers.pan: PAN must be 10 characters: 5 letters, 4 digits, and 1 letter. The 4th letter must be a valid holder type code.

registration.heading: Enter GST registration details
registration.description: Capture the GST registration and principal place of business details manually.

location.requesting: We requested browser location access to auto-fill district, pincode, and state.
location.success: District, pincode, and state were auto-filled from your current location when available.
location.unsupported: This browser cannot share location here. Enter district, pincode, and state manually.

location.timeout: Location lookup timed out. Enter district, pincode, and state manually.
location.notFound: We could not map this location to district, pincode, and state. Enter them manually.
location.lookupFailed: We could not fetch address details from your location. Enter district, pincode, and state manually.

helpers.gstin: Enter the GSTIN exactly as shown on the registration certificate. The system validates the format only in this rollout.
helpers.eInvoiceApplicable: Turn this on only if this GST registration needs IRN generation for applicable B2B invoices.
helpers.eWayBillApplicable: Turn this on if this registration issues or dispatches goods that may need e-way bills.

branches.description: Add the branches that will use GSTFY under this GST registration.
branches.principalCaptured: Principal place of business is already captured in the GST step.
branches.pendingPrincipal: Complete the GST registration step to save the principal place of business.
branches.branchDescription: Use one card per store, warehouse, office, or factory location that will operate in the system.

account.caReferralInvalid: Unable to verify this referral code.
account.workspaceUrlHelper: After registration, your team signs in from this workspace login.

business.title: Business details
business.description: Registration identity stays locked. Contact details and the principal place of business can be updated here.

registrationIdentity.title: Registered business identity
registrationIdentity.description: These details are verified registration records and cannot be edited here.

workspaceLogo.title: Workspace logo
workspaceLogo.emptyDescription: Shown in the sidebar and workspace switcher. It will be cropped square before saving.

workspaceUrl.title: Workspace URL
workspaceUrl.locked: Workspace URL is locked after creation.
workspaceUrl.generateHelper: Generate a URL for this legacy workspace.

editableDetails.title: Editable details
editableDetails.helper: Click edit to update contacts and address.

caReferral.title: CA referral
caReferral.description: Enter the referral code shared by your CA. Once verified, it becomes locked for this business.
caReferral.connectedDescription: This workspace is connected to {{practiceName}} for client filing access.
caReferral.verifiedOn: Verified on {{date}}. This code cannot be changed.
caReferral.verifyHelper: We verify the code before saving the CA relationship.

invoice.title: Invoice settings
invoice.description: Set the default invoice style and numbering prefix used when new sales invoices are created.

logo.title: Invoice logo
logo.emptyDescription: Shown on sales and purchase invoice PDFs. It will keep a wide logo shape.

template.label: Invoice template
template.description: {{templateDescription}} The same layout is used for sales invoices and purchase invoice exports.
template.helper: All document samples use the same GST invoice structure, so GSTFY keeps one standard invoice template.

fields.invoicePrefixHelper: Prefix is limited to uppercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.
fields.watermarkHelper: Printed as a light background watermark. Leave blank to hide it.

gst.title: GST rate slabs
gst.description: Control which GST slabs appear while creating invoices. Product-level tax can still differ by HSN.

enabledSlabs.label: Enabled invoice slabs
enabledSlabs.helper: Enable only the slabs your team should see as invoice choices.

cess.label: Compensation cess categories
cess.description: Does {{businessName}} sell any products that may attract GST compensation cess? Enable only the categories you need in the product master.
cess.helper: These are system-created product-selectable cess rules. Exact cess rates must be reviewed before live billing because compensation cess depends on notified goods and can change.

printer.title: Printer settings
printer.description: These preferences shape browser-based invoice printing and PDF print layouts. GSTFY does not bind to a physical printer device from the web app.

fields.compactLayoutHelper: Compact layout reduces spacing for tighter printouts on smaller formats.

inventory.title: Inventory policy
inventory.description: Control how stock postings behave across product stock, POS, sales, purchases, transfers, and adjustments.

postingBehavior.title: Posting behavior
postingBehavior.description: Inventory screens now focus on operational work. Policy changes live here so stock controls are configured once for the whole business.

automation.title: Automation
automation.description: Let GSTFY handle low-risk background work after the dealer posts a bill, imports a statement, or creates an eligible GST document.

recent.title: Recent automation
recent.description: Queued background actions for stock checks, e-invoice, and bank matching.
recent.empty: No background work has been queued yet.

barcode.title: Barcode scanner
barcode.description: USB and Bluetooth barcode scanners usually work like a keyboard. Connect the scanner, place the cursor in a barcode field, then scan. GSTFY listens for the configured suffix key.

test.title: Test scanner input
test.description: Click the input, scan one product barcode, then check the detected result.
test.scanPlaceholder: Click here and scan a barcode
test.scanHelper: If your scanner can be configured, set its suffix to Enter or Tab.

behavior.title: Scanner behavior
behavior.description: These preferences are used by this browser/device for product and POS barcode fields.
behavior.autoSearchHelper: When enabled, POS/product fields can search immediately after the scanner suffix is received.

logoCrop.invoiceDescription: Crop the invoice logo as a wide rectangle so it fits the invoice header cleanly.
logoCrop.workspaceDescription: Make the workspace logo square so it fits the sidebar and account switcher cleanly.

BLOCK.label: Block transactions
BLOCK.description: Prevent sales, transfers, and adjustments that would make stock negative.

WARN.label: Warn and allow
WARN.description: Show a warning but allow the transaction for controlled exceptions.

ALLOW.label: Allow silently
ALLOW.description: Permit negative stock without interruption. Use only for loose stock control.

WEIGHTED_AVERAGE.label: Weighted average
WEIGHTED_AVERAGE.description: Recalculate average cost as stock is purchased or adjusted.

FIFO.label: FIFO foundation
FIFO.description: Keep FIFO configured for future batch-layer valuation workflows.

autoStockAccountingEnabled.label: Stock posting
autoStockAccountingEnabled.description: After purchase, sales, POS, and opening stock entries, GSTFY checks that inventory ledgers are synced.

autoEInvoiceEnabled.label: E-invoice generation
autoEInvoiceEnabled.description: Eligible B2B documents can be queued for IRN generation without asking the dealer to repeat work.

bankAutoMatchHighConfidenceEnabled.label: Bank auto-match
bankAutoMatchHighConfidenceEnabled.description: Imported statement lines and posted bank/UPI/card entries are matched when amount, date, and reference are confident.

notifyAutomationFailures.label: Failure alerts
notifyAutomationFailures.description: Show automation failures so the owner can fix missing data before GST filing or reconciliation.

hero.title: Tell us what to fix next
hero.subtitle: Your feedback becomes fixes.
hero.description: Tell us what slowed down billing, GST filing, inventory, or payments. We use repeated feedback to decide the next product fix.
hero.compactDescription: Pick the area, rate the effort, and write the exact fix needed.
hero.meta: 2 min survey · dealer-first fixes · no support ticket

category.title: What should we fix?
category.description: Choose the area that needs attention first.

feeling.title: How did it feel?
feeling.description: Tell us the overall experience in one tap.

effort.title: How much effort did it take?
effort.description: This helps us find the workflows that need simplification.

feedback.title: What should change?
feedback.description: Write the exact issue or improvement. Keep it practical.

form.placeholder: Tell us the screen and what felt wrong.

submitted.title: Your feedback is submitted
submitted.cooldown: We lock repeat feedback for 7 days so repeated signals stay clean. You can send the next feedback after {{date}}.

errors.signInAgain: Sign in again to send feedback.
errors.generic: Unable to send feedback right now.
